title: Clockwork
source: New for the Music Lab (Claudette), Oct 25 2026

parts.name: Bass riff
parts.description: A sixteenth-note riff that turns like a gear; a turn every fourth bar; alone in the bass break.

parts.name: Drums
parts.description: Funk: sixteenth hats, ghost notes, kick on one, the a-of-one and the and-of-three; fills.

parts.name: Tick-tock
parts.description: The clock: eighth notes that never stop -- until the ending winds them down.

parts.name: Melody
parts.description: Theme one (a call), theme two (singing), the bridge, trading.

parts.name: Answers
parts.description: Theme one's reply in thirds -- and a solo.

parts.name: Brass hits
parts.description: Stabs every other bar; gear clicks in the break; a solo in the trading.

parts.name: Long notes
parts.description: Held notes under theme two, the bridge (swelling) and the last groove.
